description: This script is a build utility for generating and writing a build stamp file containing the current Git commit hash and timestamp. It includes functions to resolve the current Git HEAD revision and write metadata to a JSON file in the 'dist' directory. The script also includes a command-line interface entry point that executes the main function when run directly.

methods.name: resolveGitHead
methods.description: Resolves and returns the current Git HEAD commit hash by executing 'git rev-parse HEAD'. Returns null if the command fails or is not in a Git repository.

methods.name: writeBuildStamp
methods.description: Creates the 'dist' directory if it doesn't exist, and writes a JSON file with build timestamp and Git HEAD hash at '.buildstamp' inside the 'dist' directory.
